checkedAlternates.risk: Raspberries are called berries in everyday cooking.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Botanically, a raspberry is an aggregate fruit of many drupelets (group-1), not a berry.

checkedAlternates.risk: Bananas look nothing like small culinary berries.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Botanically, a banana develops from a single ovary with a fleshy pericarp, making it a true berry (group-4).
